info.description:
# Slaras Nusa Foodlab API

Laravel 11 REST API for the Slaras Nusa Foodlab ERP. All endpoints are served under `/api`.

## Base URL
`{{baseURL}}` defaults to `http://localhost:8080` — the docker nginx port follows
`BACKEND_HTTP_PORT`. Every request path already includes `/api`.

## Authentication
Sanctum personal access tokens (`Authorization: Bearer {{bearerToken}}`).

1. Run **Auth > Login** (`admin@foodlab.test` / `password` with the default seeder).
2. The test script saves `data.token` into `bearerToken`.
3. Every other request inherits the collection auth.

Public endpoints: `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, `GET /api/health`, `GET /api/metrics`.

Every `/api` response is forced to JSON (`ForceJsonResponse`), so `Accept` headers are optional;
the collection still sends `Accept: application/json` on every request.

## Active company
`GET/POST /api/v1/active-company` selects the global company. The selection can be overridden
per request with the `X-Active-Company-Id` header (available as a disabled header on list
requests) and is used by `?active_company=1` list scoping.

## List convention
Every index endpoint supports:

- `filter[<field>]=value` — flat aliases such as `?search=` / `?company_id=` still work
- exact filters accept **multiple values** as a comma-separated list (`filter[status]=draft,approved`,
  OR-ed) or repeated arrays (`filter[status][]=draft&filter[status][]=approved`)
- **full-text search** (`search` / `filter[search]`) accepts **multiple keywords** on the
  Scout + Meilisearch resources (expense items, employees, items, packets, lab samples);
  other text filters (`name`, `code`) take a single keyword/phrase matched with `LIKE`
- blank/whitespace-only search terms are ignored
- `sort=field` / `sort=-field`
- `include=relation` (camelCase relations; `...Count` / `...Exists` variants are available too)
- `active_company=1` on company-scoped lists
- `page` + `per_page` — without them the full filtered list is returned (cached 60 s);
  `per_page` is capped at **100**

## Search (Laravel Scout + Meilisearch)
`search` / `filter[search]` runs through Laravel Scout on:

| Resource | Indexed fields |
| --- | --- |
| Expense items | `name`, `detail`, expense category name, expense type name |
| Employees | `name`, `nickname`, `nik_ktp`, attendance code, `email`, `phone` |
| Items | `code`, `name`, `type` |
| Packets | `name` |
| Lab samples | `batch_code`, `product_name`, `category`, `status` |

- Multiple space-separated keywords are supported (`filter[search]=teh botol`); Meilisearch
  tokenises them, tolerates typos and prefix-matches the last term.
- Results are automatically scoped to the request's company (`X-Active-Company-Id`,
  `?active_company=1`, or `filter[company_id]`) where the model is company-scoped.
- If Scout is disabled (driver `null`) or the term contains `%`/`_`, the API falls back to SQL
  `LIKE` with the whole value escaped.
- All other text filters (`name`, `code`, `brand_name`, ...) remain single-keyword `LIKE`
  searches; "Full-text search (multiple keywords)" examples are attached to the five Scout lists.

## Writes
- `POST` / `PUT` / `PATCH` / `DELETE` run in DB transactions; deletes are soft deletes.
- `PATCH` is a real partial update (`sometimes` rules): send only the changed fields.
- Optional `Idempotency-Key` header on POST: the same key + payload within 300 s replays the
  cached 2xx response (`X-Idempotency-Replayed: true`); a different payload returns `422`.
- Duplicate active records (DB-level race) surface as `422` with `errors.duplicate`.

## Payroll workspace
The payroll input flow lives under `/api/v1/modules/cho/payroll`:

- `GET /workspace` — computed grid for a `company_id` + `period` (`YYYY-MM`). Attendance is
  counted in the cutoff window **22nd of the previous month → 21st of the period month**
  (`period_start_day` 22, `cutoff_day` 21, `effective_work_days` 25). Nothing is persisted;
  `payroll_item_id` stays `null` for unsaved rows.
- `POST /save-row` — persists one employee row as a `draft` payroll item and creates a draft
  payroll run for the period when needed (server-calculated salary, BPJS, PPh 21, total net).
- `POST /finalize-row` — locks the row (`status: finalized`, `finalized_by`, `finalized_at`);
  finalized rows are no longer recalculated.

## Responses
- Single resource: `{ "data": { ... } }`
- List: `{ "data": [ ... ], "meta": { "count", "total", "page", "per_page", "last_page", ... } }`
- Delete: `{ "message": "..." }`
- Validation failure: `422` with `{ "message", "errors": { field: [...] } }`
- Missing/invalid token: `401` with `{ "message": "Unauthenticated." }`

## Modules
| Module | Overview | Resources |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CFO (Keuangan) | `GET /api/v1/modules/cfo` (+ `/enums`) | companies, capital-companies, company-assets, expense-categories, expense-types, expense-items |
| CHO (SDM) | `GET /api/v1/modules/cho` (+ `/enums`) | employee-positions, employment-statuses, payroll-grades, tax-statuses, employees, payroll-runs, payroll-items, payroll (workspace, save-row, finalize-row) |
| CPO (Persediaan) | `GET /api/v1/modules/cpo` (+ `/enums`) | items, packets, packet-names, packet-vendors, packet-categories, item-packets, default-packages (+ `/wizard`), ingredients |
| CDO | `GET /api/v1/modules/cdo` | overview only |
| CMO | `GET /api/v1/modules/cmo` | overview only |
| HR | — (no overview) | employee-shifts, employee-shift-assignments, employee-attendances (+ `/scan`) |

`GET /api/v1/modules` aggregates the five launcher modules (HR is not included).

Other endpoints: `GET/POST /api/v1/samples`, `GET /api/v1/samples/{id}`,
`POST /api/v1/documents`, `POST /api/v1/modules/cho/employees/upload-document`.

## Notes
- CHO master dictionaries (positions, employment statuses, payroll grades, tax statuses) and
  CPO packets/packet names/categories/vendors are global; employees, payroll, attendance and
  CFO data are company-scoped.
- CPO inventory uses an **exclusive owner**: items, item packets and default packages belong to
  either a company (`company_id`) or a packet vendor (`packet_vendor_id`) — exactly one.
- Companies carry a `type` (`CompanyType`: Utama, Packing, Kelengkapan, Sarpras, Bahan).
- All writes invalidate the related list caches (and the active-company cache where relevant).
- Interactive OpenAPI docs are generated by Scramble at `/docs/api` (`/docs/api.json`).

`GET /api/v1/modules/cfo/companies` — Companies list.

- Sorts: `id`, `name`, `series`, `type`, `created_at`, `updated_at` (default `-id`)

item.description:
Payroll input flow for a period. The monthly attendance window is **period start day 22** of the previous month through **cutoff day 21** of the period month, with 25 effective work days.

1. `GET /payroll/workspace` computes preview rows per employee (attendance days, base salary from the payroll grade, BPJS, PPh 21, total net) without persisting anything.
2. `POST /payroll/save-row` persists one employee's row as a `draft` payroll item, creating a draft payroll run for the period when needed.
3. `POST /payroll/finalize-row` locks the row (`status: finalized`, `finalized_by`, `finalized_at`); finalized rows are no longer recalculated.

- A third scan is rejected with `422`.

Resolve the employee with `employee_attendance_code` (and optional `company_id`) or `employee_id`. `scanned_at` defaults to now.
